name: Kissing Therapy: Proper Counseling
source:
Rose is the new counselor in a quick-start community college run by her old college rival, Amy. Rose relentlessly pursues her rival and boss in hopes of getting her removed from her position as a drug scandal rocks the schools reputation. What is going on at the school that's got her so worked up, and how will the rivalry between these two determined women end?

[From [url=https://outbreakgames.itch.io/kissing-therapy-proper-counseling]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
罗斯是一所快速启动的社区大学的新辅导员，该大学由她的大学老对手艾米经营。由于毒品丑闻影响了学校的声誉，罗斯无情地追捕她的竞争对手和老板，希望能让她下台。学校里发生了什么让她如此激动，这两个意志坚定的女人之间的竞争将如何结束？

[来自[url=https://outbreakgames.itch.io/kissing-therapy-proper-counseling]itch.io[/url]]
